objects.text: The pipeline shall ingest an MLDS scene and preserve stable object identities.
The pipeline shall derive room semantics grounded in existing MLDS objects.
The pipeline shall synthesize backend-compatible spatial agent roles.
Every generated agent knowledge tag shall be covered by materialized knowledge.
Every generated agent shall be placed inside the room without obstacle overlap.
The generated behavior shall be traceable from requirements to runtime actions and validation cases.

objects.name: Case Study Engineer
objects.text: Provides MLDS input and runs the validation pipeline.

objects.name: Room Guide

objects.purpose: Display and demonstration of company products and technologies to attract interest.

objects.name: Demo Kiosk Interaction Zone
objects.purpose: Interactive kiosks for product demos or company information accessible via touchscreen interfaces.

objects.name: Refreshment and Lounge Area
objects.purpose: Area for visitors to relax, have refreshments, and informal conversations.

objects.name: Reception Agent
objects.persona: Friendly and welcoming guide who provides initial orientation and basic company information to visitors, helping them navigate the booth efficiently.

objects.name: Benefits Information Specialist
objects.persona: Knowledgeable and approachable specialist focused on explaining employee benefits and company culture, assisting visitors with interactive terminals and panels.

objects.name: Recruiting Agent
objects.persona: Professional and helpful recruiting expert who assists visitors with job applications, provides detailed recruiting information, and answers related questions.

objects.name: Demo Technician
objects.persona: Enthusiastic and tech-savvy specialist who manages product showcases and VR/AR stations, guiding visitors through interactive demos and answering technical questions.

objects.name: Hospitality Agent
objects.persona: Warm and attentive hospitality professional dedicated to providing refreshments and ensuring visitor comfort in the lounge area.

objects.name: Runtime Orchestrator
objects.purpose: Executable provider for pipeline and runtime-infrastructure capability uses.
